[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Huvis''' was the commanding officer of [[Tirgee Benyalle]]'s [[Tirgee Benyalle's luxury sail barge|luxury sail barge]]. Huvis was killed by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]] who tried to take over the craft.
